name: Арена PvP — Довод Эндалора, 21:9, фон боя пять на пять. На одобрение автора: не запускалось. Пока фон — арена недели Эхо (screens/arena.js, arBg)
style: Art style: hand-painted stylized dark-fantasy game art for a mobile RPG. Painterly digital illustration with visible, confident brush strokes and simplified planar shapes, crisp rim light on edges, strong readable silhouettes, deep near-black shadows. Light tells the story: a few strong sources — crystals and cracks that glow from within — throw colored light upward, the light comes from below. Cold and warm light contrast. Dust motes and grains of sand float in the light. Moderate detail, clean readable forms. No photorealism, no 3D-render look, no anime. Match the brushwork, lighting and color handling of the attached style reference images (approved game art), but do NOT copy their subjects, objects, letters or composition unless told to.
negative: No text, no letters, no numbers, no real-world alphabets, no watermark, no signature, no logo, no UI elements, no border or frame around the picture.

arenas.frame: Format: wide horizontal battle background for a landscape phone screen, 21:9. Strict top-down orthographic view, the camera looks straight down at the floor like a tabletop RPG battle map: no horizon, no perspective walls, no ceiling, no sky. The game puts its cards along the left and right sides: five hero cards in the left quarter and five enemy cards in the right quarter, from the top edge to the bottom edge. So the left quarter (0-25% of the width) and the right quarter (75-100% of the width) must be open, flat, evenly lit floor over their whole height — no objects there. The floor continues beyond the left and right edges of the picture: there are no side walls. Walls or balustrades appear only as a thin strip along the very top and bottom edges, no more than 7% of the height. All details are placed only in the central half (25-75% of the width), close to the top and bottom edges; the middle of the central half stays calm, because the game shows banners there.

jobs.subject: Subject: the floor of the Dovod, a small round dueling ground of mages in the flying city of Endalor, seen from straight above. A wide flat floor of pale worn stone slabs, across it one large inlaid ring of dark metal, so big that it runs off the left and right edges of the picture; the two cards areas stand inside the ring on plain stone. In the central half only, near the top edge and near the bottom edge: a low stone judges' step with a closed heavy record book lying on it, a tall brass hourglass on a stand, and five small emblems set into the stone along the ring — a water drop, an hourglass, a rough boulder, a whirlwind, a flame — each glowing faintly in its own color. Thin cracks in the stone glow with calm green Energium light from below, the city's own light; a few cold blue lamps of stored energy stand at the very top and bottom edge. The mood is a formal duel under witnesses, not a bloody pit: clean stone, old scorch marks and scratches of past duels, grains of sand in the light. No people, no characters, no cards, no banners with letters, no grid.
